# CompTIA

> CompTIA is the leading provider of IT, cybersecurity, AI, and data certifications with training solutions for enterprises, government, education, and individual career advancement.

CompTIA offers comprehensive IT certification pathways including Security+, Network+, and emerging certifications in AI and cloud technologies. The platform serves multiple audiences through specialized programs for enterprises, government agencies, academic institutions, and training partners, with tools like Careers+ for career exploration and CertMaster for learning delivery.

## Key Topics

- IT Certifications
- Cybersecurity
- Security+
- Cloud Computing
- AI & Data
- Careers+
- CertMaster
- Workforce Development
- Career Pathways
- Tech Skills
- CompTIA Client Proctor
- Network+
- SecAI+
- Job Roles
- Career Advancement

## Certifications & Learning

- [IT, AI, and Data Certifications](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/certifications): Comprehensive catalog of CompTIA certifications including Security+, Network+, and emerging AI/data certifications.
- [CompTIA Homepage](https://www.comptia.org/en-US): CompTIA homepage offering IT certifications, training, and exam resources.
- [CompTIA Resources](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/resources): CompTIA resources hub with training, exam scheduling, and digital badges.

## Career Exploration & Development

- [Explore Tech Careers and Industry Pathways](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/explore-careers): Explore tech careers, industry sectors, and skill requirements with Careers+.
- [Careers+](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/explore-careers/careers-plus): CompTIA Careers+ career exploration tool for tech job roles and pathways.
- [Industry Sectors](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/explore-careers/industry-sectors): Discover technology innovation across cybersecurity, AI, cloud, and networking sectors.

## Enterprise & Government Solutions

- [CompTIA for Enterprise](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/enterprise): Enterprise IT training and certification programs for tech team upskilling.
- [CompTIA for Government](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/government): Government IT certifications for federal, state, and local agencies.
- [Federal Government IT Certifications](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/government/federal): Federal government IT certifications for DoD, military, and civilian agencies.
- [State & Local Government IT Certifications](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/government/state-and-local): State and local government IT training and certification solutions.

## Academic Programs

- [CompTIA for Education](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic): CompTIA IT certifications and resources for higher and secondary education.
- [Higher Education IT Certifications](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic/higher-education): Higher education IT certifications, courseware, and career pathways.
- [Secondary Education IT Certifications](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic/secondary-education): Secondary education IT certifications and job-ready skills training.
- [CompTIA for Students](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic/student): Student certifications, IT training, and Careers+ career development resources.
- [CompTIA for Instructors](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/academic/instructor): Instructor resources, curriculum tools, and CompTIA Instructor Network.

## Partner & Research

- [CompTIA Training Delivery Partners](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/partner): Partner program for CompTIA training delivery with CertMaster tools and resources.
- [CompTIA Research](https://www.comptia.org/en-us/resources/research): CompTIA research reports on tech workforce, cybersecurity trends, and job market analysis.
